from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/workspace/android-studio-parallel-sync-policy')
BASE = Path('/workspace/android-studio-artifacts/parallel-sync-integration/runtime')
SOURCE = '4fb7a80eacc598a786b4b98c809d1df24a1b02ee'
PATHS = ['.', ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/*.md',
         ':(exclude)docs/android-studio/reference-manifest.json',
         ':(exclude)docs/android-studio/test-parity.json',
         ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/ports/*.json',
         ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/evidence/**/*.log',
         ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/evidence/**/*.json']

def sha(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT)

def snapshot():
    assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == SOURCE
    for cached in [False, True]:
        subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--quiet'] + (['--cached'] if cached else []) +
                       [SOURCE, '--', *PATHS], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    assert not git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '--', *PATHS)
    paths = [path.decode() for path in git('ls-files', '-z', '--', *PATHS).split(b'\0') if path]
    bindings = {path: sha(ROOT / path) for path in paths if (ROOT / path).is_file()}
    assert len(bindings) == 4730
    expected = json.loads((BASE / 'whole-source-static-guard.json').read_text())
    assert bindings == expected['files']
    return {'source_commit': SOURCE, 'tree': git('rev-parse', SOURCE + '^{tree}').decode().strip(),
            'fixed_source_pathspec': PATHS, 'files': bindings,
            'index_hex': git('ls-files', '--stage', '-z').hex(),
            'status_hex': git('status', '--porcelain=v1', '-z').hex()}

before = snapshot()
assert before == json.loads((BASE / 'ui-full-default-suite-source-after.json').read_text())
assert before['status_hex'] == ''
receipts = []
for relative in ['retry1/all-features-tests-verified.json',
                 'retry1/library-build-verified.json', 'retry1/strict-clippy-verified.json',
                 'retry1/format-check-verified.json', 'ui-full-default-suite-verified.json']:
    path = BASE / relative
    item = json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert item['source_commit'] == SOURCE and item['exit_code'] == 0
    assert item['whole_source_bindings'] == 4730 and item['source_index_status_unchanged']
    assert sha(Path(item['log'])) == item['log_sha256']
    receipts.append({'path': str(path), 'sha256': sha(path), 'command': item['command'],
                     'log_sha256': item['log_sha256'], 'elapsed_seconds': item['elapsed_seconds']})
unit = json.loads((BASE / 'retry1/all-features-tests-verified.json').read_text())
assert (unit['passed'], unit['failed'], unit['ignored'], unit['filtered']) == (261, 0, 0, 0)
tests = [a for a in unit['compiler_artifacts'] if a['executable'] and a['profile']['test']]
assert len(tests) == 9 and all(not a['fresh'] for a in tests)
assert all(a['target']['src_path'].startswith(str(ROOT) + '/') for a in tests)
frozen = unit['frozen_policy_executable']
assert Path(frozen['path']).stat().st_size == frozen['bytes'] and sha(Path(frozen['path'])) == frozen['sha256']
ui = json.loads((BASE / 'ui-full-default-suite-verified.json').read_text())
assert (ui['passed'], ui['failed'], ui['pre_existing_ignored'], ui['filtered']) == (125, 0, 1, 0)
assert not ui['linker_output_redirection'] and ui['ignored_native_test_unchanged']
uia = ui['normal_current_worktree_compiler_artifacts']
assert len(uia) == 1 and not uia[0]['fresh'] and uia[0]['target']['src_path'].startswith(str(ROOT) + '/')
uielf = Path(uia[0]['executable'])
assert uielf.stat().st_size == uia[0]['executable_bytes'] and sha(uielf) == uia[0]['executable_sha256']
linked_unit = Path('/tmp/android-studio-link-output/android-tools-parallel-unit-298321')
assert linked_unit.stat().st_size == 303989152
assert sha(linked_unit) == 'cc057a4cfa9df4f9eacda0b581803c9062697db9edd4c0c651ab86512ea1'
# Process listing records states and access limitations without secrets/environment dumps.
processes, zombies, vanished = [], [], []
compiler_names = {'cargo', 'rustc', 'rustfmt', 'clippy-driver', 'cargo-clippy', 'cc', 'clang',
                  'clang++', 'gcc', 'g++', 'ld', 'ld.lld', 'lld', 'koda', 'zed'}
for entry in sorted(Path('/proc').iterdir(), key=lambda p: int(p.name) if p.name.isdigit() else -1):
    if not entry.name.isdigit():
        continue
    try:
        status = entry.joinpath('status').read_text()
        fields = {line.split(':', 1)[0]: line.split(':', 1)[1].strip() for line in status.splitlines() if ':' in line}
        state = fields['State'].split()[0]
        info = {'pid': int(entry.name), 'state': state, 'name': fields['Name'], 'uids': fields['Uid'].split()}
        if state in {'Z', 'X'}:
            zombies.append(info)
            continue
        info['exe_accessible'] = True
        try:
            info['exe_basename'] = Path(os.readlink(entry / 'exe')).name
        except PermissionError:
            info['exe_accessible'] = False
        except FileNotFoundError:
            vanished.append(info)
            continue
        try:
            info['cwd'] = os.readlink(entry / 'cwd')
        except (PermissionError, FileNotFoundError):
            info['cwd_accessible'] = False
        try:
            command = entry.joinpath('cmdline').read_bytes()
            info['gradle_daemon_observed'] = b'GradleDaemon' in command
        except (PermissionError, FileNotFoundError):
            info['cmdline_accessible'] = False
        processes.append(info)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        vanished.append({'pid': int(entry.name), 'vanished_during_observation': True})
active_compilers = [p for p in processes if p['name'] in compiler_names or p.get('exe_basename') in compiler_names]
assert not active_compilers, active_compilers
inaccessible = [p for p in processes if not p['exe_accessible']]
assert all(p['name'] in {'dockerd', 'containerd'} and p['uids'] == ['0', '0', '0', '0'] for p in inaccessible), inaccessible
# No attempt to kill, inspect protected FDs, remove caches or run any more runtime commands.
after = snapshot()
assert after == before
capacities = {}
for path in ['/workspace', '/tmp']:
    stat = os.statvfs(path)
    capacities[path] = {'available_bytes': stat.f_bavail * stat.f_frsize, 'total_bytes': stat.f_blocks * stat.f_frsize}
receipt = {'source_commit': SOURCE, 'source_tree': before['tree'],
           'completed_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
           'whole_source_files_unchanged': 4730, 'source_index_status_unchanged': before == after,
           'fixed_source_pathspec': PATHS, 'component_gates': receipts,
           'tools_tests': {'passed': 261, 'failed': 0, 'ignored': 0, 'filtered': 0, 'fresh_targets': 9},
           'ui_tests': {'passed': 125, 'failed': 0, 'pre_existing_ignored': 1, 'filtered': 0,
                        'fresh_targets': 1, 'normal_linker': True},
           'frozen_parallel_policy': frozen,
           'retained_unit_elf': {'path': str(linked_unit), 'bytes': linked_unit.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(linked_unit)},
           'retained_ui_elf': {'path': str(uielf), 'bytes': uielf.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(uielf)},
           'first_failed_attempt_preserved': {'path': str(BASE / 'all-features-tests.log'),
                     'sha256': sha(BASE / 'all-features-tests.log'), 'exit_code': 101,
                     'reason': 'ENOSPC followed by linker SIGBUS; no tests ran; infrastructure recovery, no product changes'},
           'controlled_retirement_receipts': [{'path': str(BASE / name), 'sha256': sha(BASE / name)} for name in
               ['completed-prior-251-unit-ELF-retirement.json', 'owned-failed-unit-object-retirement.json']],
           'live_process_observations': processes, 'zombie_status_observations': zombies,
           'vanished_process_observations': vanished, 'active_accessible_compilers': active_compilers,
           'inaccessible_live_infrastructure_services': inaccessible,
           'process_inspection_limit': 'Root-owned infrastructure exe/cwd/FD access is unavailable. No whole-system no-FD claim. Unowned Gradle daemon observed and untouched.',
           'capacity': capacities, 'lease_owner_processes_complete': True,
           'scope_limit': 'Component gates only; full app/native/reference exact captures/full workspace/lead merge belong to Root and are not claimed here.'}
output = BASE / 'component-validation-closure.json'
with output.open('x') as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'closure': str(output), 'sha256': sha(output), 'tools_passed': 261, 'ui_passed': 125,
                  'source_unchanged_files': 4730, 'active_accessible_compilers': active_compilers,
                  'capacity': capacities}, indent=2))
